integrity: The source multiplication and defining tensor polynomial were reconstructed from a fully inspected public preprint. Symbolic tensor coefficient calculations and independent coadjoint identities prove the general statement; exhaustive finite-field checks are replay evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic two is excluded, and all tensors are skew with respect to the printed ordered basis.

The source assumes characteristic zero; characteristic-three statements here concern explicit polynomial mock-Lie Yang–Baxter identities and associated coboundary maps, not the automatic validity of all characteristic-zero bialgebra theorems.
The reduced solution locus is described set-theoretically; no nonreduced scheme structure is claimed.
Alternative low-dimensional terminology and an incompletely inspected 2023 meeting abstract are residual originality risks.
title: A characteristic-three component jump in a four-dimensional mock-Lie Yang–Baxter locus
